title: Voice Lint and Voice Studio: readiness
statusText: 2026-09-12: standalone source d491e5b published and local runtime verified; public website deployment pending
summary: The complete Voice product is published at d491e5b on agent-orc/voice-lint main, advancing the remote from 2bcc58d. Merge 12e8bdb preserves the existing Voice Lint history and seven exported Devspace product commits through f19c7dc. All new Voice source commits belong to this standalone repository; static website artifacts belong to deploy. Both managed local apps run from C:/Projects/voice-lint. All six project IDs and browser enrollment were preserved, five internal roots were moved, and 55 session assertions plus 18 real Chrome session checks passed. Final local website verification passed 96 views and 322 links, assets and fragments; Research passed 16 checks for 30 sources and writing patterns passed 22 checks. The old active local Devspace copy is removed, its unpublished commits and 24,623 remaining files are preserved, and the published Devspace tree and history remain unchanged. Unrelated status, index entries and submodule HEADs were preserved; no Devspace commit or push was made. Public website deployment is outstanding and the target returns HTTP 404. Voice Studio remains a supervised local preview with guarded original-source review and adjacent resizable panes. Earlier evidence retains 120 layout checks and 106 backend assertions. The two libraries separate writing knowledge and host-driven tools from HTML visualization. Public pages expose no LLM capability. Reproducible offline quality evaluation is implemented; no model-quality run or measured winner exists.
